references.text: The king of Assyria carried Israel away to Assyria, a people they did not know, fulfilling the curse in Deuteronomy
King Jehoiachin was taken into exile in Babylon along with the people, fulfilling the prophecy that the king and the people would be led to a foreign nation
King Zedekiah was brought to Babylon; the king was carried off to a nation he did not know
Jeremiah prophesies that King Coniah and his mother will be cast out into another land they do not know
God says He will drive them out of the land to a country they do not know, where they will serve other gods
A parallel curse in the same chapter about being scattered among all nations and serving foreign gods made of wood and stone
Moses warns that they will serve gods of wood and stone if they break the covenant
Solomon is warned that Israel will be exiled from the land if they turn to other gods
God says that the desire to become like the nations and serve wood and stone shall never come to pass
Prophecy that the kings of Judah and their treasures will be taken to Babylon
